resources.string: With your explicit permission, this companion receives window-change metadata to show its assistant only while the official PayPal app is foregrounded. It reads accessible text only from that app for local rule-based screen classification. Optional screenshot text recognition requires a separate consent in Saathi. It does not save or upload screen text or images. It may open a small allow-listed navigation control only after you tap the matching Saathi button; it never enters financial data or authorizes payments. Disable it anytime in Accessibility settings.

Privacy first: with your permission, Saathi receives window-change metadata to show its independent assistant only over the official PayPal app. Accessible text from PayPal is used transiently on-device and is not saved or uploaded. Optional screenshot text recognition is off by default, requires separate consent, and is processed only on-device. Only the detected category and a question you submit are sent to your configured Saathi server. Saathi does not click payment buttons or make payments. Never share passwords, PINs, OTPs, or card details. Verify recipient, amount, and fees in PayPal yourself.

Before Android opens Accessibility settings, Saathi explains that the service receives window-change metadata across apps to detect when PayPal is foregrounded, but reads accessible screen text only from the official PayPal app. Optional screenshot recognition has a separate consent setting in Saathi. Enable “PayPal Saathi AI Screen Monitor” only if you agree. To stop monitoring, disable that service.

With your permission, Saathi receives window-change metadata across apps so it can show the assistant only while the official PayPal app is foregrounded. It reads accessible text only from that PayPal app, uses the text transiently for local screen classification, and never saves or uploads screen text. A separate optional setting can permit one-shot on-device screenshot text recognition when screen details are unclear; the image and recognized text are not saved or sent anywhere. The detected category is stored on this device and may be sent with a question you submit to your configured Saathi server. The floating panel is an independent overlay, is not part of PayPal, and may cover part of the screen; minimize it before using any PayPal control. Saathi can open only a verified allow-listed navigation control after you tap its matching button. It never selects recipients, enters financial data, or authorizes payments. You can disable the service in Accessibility settings at any time.
Allow optional on-device screen text recognition when screen details are unclear (Android 11+)

If accessibility evidence is insufficient on an unknown or ambiguous PayPal screen, Saathi may capture the current screen once and recognize text only on this device. The image is not saved or sent anywhere. Only fixed generic screen hints are used; OCR cannot produce actions. The transient image may include private content, so enable this only if you agree. You can turn it off here at any time. It is unavailable on Android versions below 11 and may be blocked by secure PayPal screens.
